digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: bridge_project and repos fields must be added to ticket state schema and projected by the reducer on both CREATE and EDIT events, with bridge_project as tri-state (absent/empty/set) and repos as a list
create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be added to all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) and produce identical ticket state across surfaces

bridge_project must be promote-only editable via edit_core with a guard that rejects changes to already-bound tickets while allowing edits to unbound tickets, using bindings.json as the single source of binding truth
repos must remain freely editable on the edit path without binding validation, since it never reaches the tracker

the three tri-states of bridge_project (absent for legacy, explicit empty for never-sync, key for sync-target) must be distinguishable after full replay and not conflate pre-feature stores with unsynced tickets
